facts.fact: KICTANet's memorandum of 5 May 2026 to the Senate says the Artificial Intelligence Bill, 2026 (Senate Bills No. 4 of 2025) is currently before the Senate, and describes it as creating an AI Commissioner's Office, an Advisory Committee, high-risk classification, regulatory sandboxes, transparency obligations and public sector standards.
